component.name: Ressapanda
component.summary: A 3D voxel editor built with wgpu and egui

description.p: Ressapanda is a 3D voxel editor built in Rust with wgpu and egui, made for my GameDev/3D printing needs.
Selection modes and tools are separate, in the spirit of Vim: select, then edit.

ul.li: Single, Area, Extended Area, Laser and Line selection modes
Add, Style, Delete, Cut and Color Picker tools

Voxel Groups act as layers-like semantic term, and can be moved, rotated, duplicated and recentered independently. Voxels can be moved from one voxel group to another. Group Visibility can be toggled. Invisible groups are omitted on export.
For now, Export to Wavefront OBJ, with or without a material library
Shortcuts made to be used by one hand, with the other almsot never leaving the mouse.
